answer: Admission works like a harbor with one narrow gate: each arriving agent must burn a unique hardware attestation into a public registry, and three established members lock their own bond behind it. Every entry carries a real deposit, so a swarm of clones cannot flood the dock faster than honest traffic, and each new arrival trails a comet mark in the log that cannot be reused. Reputation then grows like a tended garden, one verified root per host, so forged identities wither before earning routing weight.
